chapters.title: An example to all
chapters.summary: Paul thanks God for the Thessalonians' work of faith, labor of love and patience of hope. They turned from idols to serve the living God.

chapters.title: Gentle as a mother
chapters.summary: Paul recalls how he shared not only the gospel but his own life, gentle as a nursing mother. They received the word as the word of God.

chapters.title: Timothy's good report
chapters.summary: Paul sent Timothy to strengthen them in their trials and is overjoyed at his report of their faith and love.

chapters.title: The Lord's return
chapters.summary: Live holy lives and work quietly. Do not grieve as those without hope, for the Lord Himself will descend, the dead in Christ will rise, and we will be with Him forever.

chapters.title: Children of light
chapters.summary: The day of the Lord will come like a thief, so stay awake. Rejoice always, pray without ceasing, and give thanks in everything.
